Game Overview

Cheese Lab is a animal title where guide your little mouse through a thrilling platform adventure to delicious cheese delights. Navigate bouncy paths and master speedy jet packs while evading cunning robot cats in this whimsical escapade. Balance agility and strategy to satisfy your mouse's cheesy cravings in this exhilarating journey.
